canDoYue: 你識申請下星期年假，知道星期三係公眾假期所以只要四日，交代 Jo 會頂你個位，星期五交交接筆記，批核之後仲有五日假。
canDoEn: Ask for Monday-to-Friday leave, hear that a public holiday makes it four days, say Jo will cover the desk, send the handover on Friday, and keep five days after approval.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Hi Nina. I'd like to take annual leave next week, Monday to Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好 Nina。我下星期想放年假，星期一到星期五。
dialogue.say: Hi Nina. I'd like to take annual leave next week, Monday to Friday.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Wednesday's a public holiday, so you only need four days of leave.
dialogue.glossYue: 星期三係公眾假期，所以你只要四日假。
dialogue.say: Wednesday's a public holiday, so you only need four days of leave.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Great. Jo has agreed to cover my desk while I'm away.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。我不在嘅時候，Jo 答應幫我睇住個位。
dialogue.say: Great. Jo has agreed to cover my desk while I'm away.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Good. Please send me a handover note before you go.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。你走之前請發一份交接筆記畀我。
dialogue.say: Good. Please send me a handover note before you go.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll email it to you and Jo on Friday morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。我星期五朝早會電郵畀你同 Jo。
dialogue.say: Sure. I'll email it to you and Jo on Friday morning.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Thanks. How many leave days do you have left this year?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。你今年仲有幾多日假？
dialogue.say: Thanks. How many leave days do you have left this year?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Nine, so I'll still have five after this.
dialogue.glossYue: 九日，所以今次之後仲有五日。
dialogue.say: Nine, so I'll still have five after this.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: OK, I've approved it. Enjoy your break.
dialogue.say: OK, I've approved it. Enjoy your break.
